commit_message:
Port Python finalize parity gates

Add fail-closed run-log recovery tagging, centralize postmerge manifest/report finalization, and route merge/ship callers through the gated helper.

Port Python finalize postbump status tokens, local cleanup ordering, verify-main matching, and teardown log recovery/commit gates while keeping bash as the shipped default.

Thread CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING through RunContext, CI monitor/fix results, and ship-state persistence, using force-push recovery after rebase while preserving plain push otherwise.

Add parity gate and targeted unit coverage for recovery, context hydration, finalize, and ship caller ordering; refresh stale Makefile/docs parity comments.

Inline-triage rule 2: tolerate unwritable quiet breadcrumb log files.
